start: Start with a letter or digit (or ~ and then one)
space: A model ID can't contain spaces
control: A model ID can't contain line breaks or control characters
character: “{char}” can't be in a model ID. Use letters, digits and . _ - / : @ [ ]
rule: Letters, digits and . _ - / : @ [ ], starting with a letter or digit; a gateway's latest alias can start with ~.
